all the 66 PPNG isolates were found to harbour at least two plasmids.

all 66 PPNG strains isolated in Peninsula Malaysia were of the same type, i.e. the 2.6 and 4.4 Far-East plasmids were present in 100% of the isolates, whereas the 24.5 plasmid was present in 77%.
